name: slacklens
description: Personal Slack triage dashboard. Fetch fidelity (pinned search limits, all three buckets rendered, permalink-based dedupe). Atomic cache writes with backup + suspicious-refresh guard. Tolerant per-result parsing. DELTA refresh. Stale-cache warnings. Versioned cache. Append-only refresh log with token-cost instrumentation. Seven skills including one-command uninstall.
